messages:
Tom L: quick check 1 on the weekly KPI board: launch-post traffic jumped but CRM-accepted leads didn't. can analytics + growth confirm it's a real lift or a reporting shim? :thinking:

Priya K: saw that too. initial hypothesis: messaging variant in the post + a routing rule change yesterday. need to separate messaging-driven conversions from routing/ingest artifacts.

Nina G: i'll pull cohort-level registrant -> accepted lead conversion and overlay send-variant. want to see if variant C drove more low-quality signups that got filtered later.

Ravi S: FYI we flipped a lead-routing rule ON at 02:10 UTC to favor direct-sfdc mapping for webinar leads (was queued for April experiment). that could change counts if earlier leads were batched into manual review. logged in #eng-changes.

Tom L: good catch. two asks: 1) analytics to add a 'crm_accepted' series vs streaming signups on the KPI board; 2) growth to add subject-variant slice so we can attribute messaging separately.

Priya K: will add the CRM series and annotate the routing change. SQL I'll use to compute reconciled accepted leads:
```sql
SELECT accept_date, COUNT(DISTINCT lead_id) AS accepted_leads
FROM crm.lead_history
WHERE accept_date BETWEEN '2024-05-01' AND '2024-05-08'
AND source_campaign = 'launch-post-2024'
GROUP BY accept_date;
```

Molly H: adding subject-variant breakdown to the campaign sheet now. variant-C had higher opens but lower demo-rate in the quick sample. might be high-volume low-quality.

Nina G: linking the two series in the dashboard and adding an annotation: "routing rule toggled 02:10 UTC; subject variant C live". also adding a normalized/lagged view because CRM acceptance lags by ~24-72h.

dashbot: KPI board updated 1  annotation id a-20240502-routing and new series "crm_accepted" added. public: https://dash.redwood.com/r/kpi-launchsums

Tom L: thanks team. last ask: once the reconciled snapshot is ready, can someone post a one-paragraph note with the corrected weekly numbers and a short line about "message vs routing" for the exec digest? want to avoid an alert thread. :pray:
